# Joseph Rejo Mathew

> Portfolio of Joseph Rejo Mathew: full-stack developer and AI/ML student at RV College of Engineering, Bengaluru. Founding Engineer at Lume CXM. Open to internships and full-time roles. The site is an interactive 3D house and needs JavaScript; the links below give the same content in plain form.

Core stack: Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB and Cloudflare, with strong Java and SQL.

## Site

- [Portfolio home](https://josephrm.pages.dev/): Interactive 3D house with rooms for experience, projects, study, writing and contact. A plain-HTML fallback is included in the page source.
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://josephrm.pages.dev/assets/JOSEPH_FINAL_RESUME_2026.pdf): Current résumé.

## Projects

- [Hatch](https://github.com/AdityaKaushik295/Hatch): Hackathon management platform that won WhiteHack 1.0. Next.js, TypeScript, Flask, MongoDB, Firebase.
- [QuarksFinance](https://github.com/Joseph25Rejo/QuarksFinance): Algorithmic stock trading platform with backtesting, live signals and sentiment.
- [ParkNGo](https://github.com/Joseph25Rejo/ParknGo-appln): Smart parking with ML-driven dynamic pricing.
